name: Shanghai Geoharbour Construction Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Geoharbour Construction Group Co., Ltd., based in Shanghai, China, is a firm established in 2000 that provides extensive geotechnical services across the country. Their expertise covers a wide array of activities including engineering design, investigation, consulting, research, and specialized geotechnical construction. The company's service offerings include critical areas such as ground improvement techniques, pile foundation installation, deep foundation pit construction, slope stabilization, land reclamation, and harbor development projects. They undertake a diverse range of infrastructure initiatives, from ports and airports to railways, power plants, and industrial parks.
